cases.title: First lesson, no layer in mind: the opening asks one thing (TD 19): intent question first, one-sentence fallback proposal with a hinge, ends on the choice; no leave-out, no idea statement, no other-skill recap

checks.detail: said "First lesson on this skill." before the first snapshot

rubric.reason: The turn opens with a real question, "Which layer would you like to turn or grow from a spot other than its middle, and which spot should it turn from: a corner, an edge, or the middle?", before the mentor names any place.
It offers one fallback in one sentence with a hinge, "Door could swing from its left edge. Want to try that one?", which matches the snapshot proposal (Door, middle-left).
The only layer named is Door, which appears in the anchor_snapshot candidates and proposal; no properties or times are mentioned.
The opening is the intent question plus a one-sentence fallback proposal, with no leave-out, idea statement or other-skill recap, and it ends on the choice "Want to try that one?"

The fallback offers only the snapshot's proposal with a hinge, "Door could swing from its left edge. Want to try that one?", which matches proposal Door / middle-left and leaves the learner free to choose another.
